geography: Delhi citywide as published by Delhi Traffic Police
series_extension_assessment: 2011-2013 total accidents, fatal accidents and persons killed can extend the existing citywide published-count trend in a later approved change; 2014-2015 are already present. Injury and category counts require explicit source-edition selection. No district allocation is implied.
definition_limit: Published police counts. A 30-day fatality follow-up definition was not established in the retrieved historical source; do not label these as standardized 30-day mortality rates.
